author: P B
text:
From the moment we entered, the whole place felt so warm, pretty, and comforting. The ambiance is absolutely beautiful and has such a soft elegant vibe that genuinely makes women feel treated like princesses 👑🌸 Every corner of the café is picture perfect and I honestly had the best time clicking so many cute pictures and just enjoying the moment.

A very special thank you to Sai Lakshmi ❤️
She made our experience unforgettable with the way she treated us. She was so sweet, calm, professional, caring, and genuinely welcoming throughout. The way she suggested drinks and food with so much patience and kindness made us feel really comfortable and special. You can truly see how dedicated she is to her work. Her cute and decent nature added such positive energy to our visit and people like her are the reason customers leave with a smile and want to come back again 🥹✨

We tried the Irish Cream Shake and the special Cranberry Mojito and both tasted absolutely amazing 🤍 The food and drinks were prepared so well and everything felt premium and worth it.

One more thing I absolutely loved was the cutest little toys they had for sale 🧸💕 They were adorable and surprisingly very reasonably priced too.

Overall, this place gave me such a happy and peaceful feeling. Good ambiance, amazing taste, lovely staff, beautiful aesthetics, and such positive vibes all around ✨
Wishing Euphoria Cafe and the entire team lots of success and happiness for the future. You truly deserve all the love and growth coming your way 💐 Can’t wait to visit again already 💖

author: AISHWARYA SWAMY
text:
This is a unique café-cum-gaming house and a great place to meet new people, collaborate, and build connections. I visited for an indoor board games community event, and I was impressed by their huge collection of board games catering to all kinds of players. The café has a cozy interior with a great vibe, making it perfect to visit with friends or even solo if you're open to interacting with strangers.
Apart from board games, they also have a few casual games like foosball, carrom, and giant Snakes & Ladders. The food menu is quite limited, but whatever I tried was good. It's an excellent place to unplug from your phone, enjoy quality time, and have a fun, relaxing weekend. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely visit again.
